_approach: The Afro-tech strand (Da Capo, Joezi, Shimza): tighter, darker, closer to techno. A hard 909-style kick, offbeat closed hats with ghost 16ths in front of them, a 3+3+2 woodblock/clave timeline, a soft 16th shaker bed, minimal clap and a couple of tom jabs. Swing is minimal - the groove is mechanical and hypnotic by design. Ref: Da Capo 'Kelele' (2020), Joezi 'Wandi' (2021). (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
